page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.16xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. It features 64 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 64 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core performance, with top-tier results in stress-ng multi-core CPU tests, Geekbench multi-core scores, and Passmark CPU evaluations. The processor's capabilities are highlighted by strong performance in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, software compilation using Clang, ray tracing, and image processing. Cryptographic operations also perform strongly, as evidenced by Passmark CPU encryption benchmarks. Single-core performance and memory bandwidth (both read and write) fall within the average range.

Given its compute-heavy profile and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.c7t.16xlarge is highly efficient for workloads requiring dense parallel processing without massive memory footprints. Strong benchmarks in database operations, static web serving throughput, and small-model LLM inference make it suitable for high-throughput web serving, software compilation pipelines, and parallelized data processing. The lack of local storage requires external network-attached storage, which should be factored into the overall architectural cost.
